scientific_integrity: Proof reconstructs all survival sequences or their first four raw-step values, establishes hazard monotonicity exactly, and treats finite-support boundary cases.
Exact-rational verification checks selected parameters only; it is not substituted for universal proof.
No independent audit, independent validation, or certified mathematical originality is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only a lower absorbing barrier at -1 and an upper absorbing barrier at integer b>=1, starting at zero.
Requires iid biased nearest-neighbor steps with p strictly between zero and one and a two-step-grouped exit lifetime.
Does not generalize the classification to arbitrary asymmetric pairs or time-varying boundaries.
A mathematically equivalent result under a different ageing/reliability formulation remains a residual literature risk.
title: Sharp asymmetric gambler’s-ruin ageing transition at a one-step lower barrier
